client.business_model: Multi-site outpatient medication-assisted treatment (MAT) provider for opioid and alcohol use disorders
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health delivers MAT-based addiction care that combines FDA-approved medications with counseling and case management. Council Capital acquired the company in 2017, after which SaVida expanded from a regional provider to operating clinics across several Northeastern and Mid-Atlantic states.

revenue.source: LeadIQ company profile for SaVida Health (https://leadiq.com/c/savida-health/5c6a313b20000097313b8d4d)
revenue.notes: LeadIQ estimates annual revenue between $50 M and $100 M. No corroborating figures found in official filings or press releases; midpoint of published range shown. Treated as low confidence.

locations.notes: Article states SaVida operated 22 outpatient treatment centers as of Nov-2020. Company has announced additional openings (e.g., Danville VA in 2024 press release), so actual 2025 total is likely higher, but no authoritative current count was located.

employees.source: LeadIQ employee directory for SaVida Health (https://leadiq.com/c/savida-health/5c6a313b20000097313b8d4d/employee-directory)
employees.notes: LeadIQ lists approximately 165 employees as of Oct-2025. No employee figures found on official website or LinkedIn company page.
